column1: # P1 fixed range [0x00f4fa, 0x054c3c): course data (4 courses x 18 hole
# records + per-course trailing RLE/lists) and the trig tables.  Decoded and
# parser-validated by the p1-fixdata lane; full write-up and consumer map in
# the private lane report
# Course data: records reached via the course directory at 0x57b44 (walked by
# FUN_00058988 @0x58988: 4 course tables x 18 entries x 24 bytes, entry long
# 0 = record address).  Each record: 22-byte header (flags, par, 4 pointers,
# width, height cells) + RLE tilemap that FUN_0005a054 @0x5a054 decodes via
# FUN_0005a428 @0x5a428 into exactly width*height words, plus object lists
# (FUN_00002d8a @0x2d8a), pair lists (FUN_00062a4a @0x62a4a) and coord
# tools/lane_fixdata_tables.py validates all 72 records: header fields, RLE
# decodes == w*h for 72/72, every sub-list tiles to the next record, and the
# four course blocks tile the span exactly.
# Format: <hex start>  <hex size>  <kind>  <name>  <evidence>
00f4fa
